name: Dieter Helsnicht
canonNotes: An ancient Necromancer who has spent centuries without living company, served only by mindless Undead who never question him.
Slowly slipping back into madness, his mind sharpens only when he is called to prove the supremacy of his dark arts.
voiceNotes: Distracted, rambling and imperious; unused to being questioned.
Snaps into cold focus when his craft is challenged.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
